maya (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — we ran out of time on the review / leveling questions. Drop anything here and we'll tag the right folks.

maya (People Ops): TL;DR: review cycle timeline + a few clarifications below, full doc: https://redwood.example.com/hr/review-cycle-2026 :point_up:

sam (IC): Thanks — timeline? when do managers submit calibration forms?

maya (People Ops): Kickoff: May 10. Manager nominations & self-reviews due: May 24. Calibration window: Jun 1–7. Notifications go out Jun 21.

jordan (Mgr, Platform): If someone joined 2 months ago, are they eligible for promo this cycle?

maya (People Ops): Short answer: generally need 6 months in role for a standard promotion review. Exceptions possible for rapid scope increases — require manager+director signoff and a note in calibration.

aaron (VP Eng): To add: for exceptions we ask teams to include a short evidence packet (projects, impact, stakeholder feedback). Helps calibration move faster.

sam (IC): Is there a difference between a comp change vs title change in timing?

maya (People Ops): Yes — title changes follow the same cadence as promotions. Comp-only adjustments (market adjustments, spot bonuses) can happen off-cycle — submit via the CompChange form and we'll route for approvals.

lin (CTO): Also note we have a small pool for mid-cycle market adjustments. Prioritization is for retention risk + critical hires.

jordan (Mgr, Platform): For IC -> Manager transitions, do we treat that as a promotion (band change) or a lateral with responsibility shift?

maya (People Ops): IC->Manager is a promotion for leveling purposes if the role maps to a manager band. Submit a role profile and manager competencies; compensation will be evaluated against manager bands.

sam (IC): Equity refresh cadence? when can folks expect grants if promoted?

peopleops-bot: New doc version posted: https://redwood.example.com/hr/equity-refresh-2026 — typical refresh window is post-notification (late Jun) for folks receiving promotions; timing depends on board approvals.

maya (People Ops): Equity: promoted folks are eligible for refresh consideration in the next grant window; not guaranteed but prioritized in the late-June grant run.

sam (IC): Any change to 401k match or benefits this year?

maya (People Ops): No change to core 401k match for 2026. Open enrollment dates unchanged: Oct 1–15. We'll announce any voluntary benefit vendors earlier if added.

jordan (Mgr, Platform): Can managers update calibration data after the window closes if something urgent comes up?

maya (People Ops): We prefer updates during the window. After it closes, PMs/HR can accept urgent late notes with a written justification; we'll review but can't promise changes unless material.

aaron (VP Eng): One more ask — please include concrete examples of impact in manager notes (metrics, customer/stakeholder quotes). It saves follow-ups in calibration.

sam (IC): Thanks — will do.

maya (People Ops): If anyone wants an offline sync, book a 15-min slot on my calendar — I'll run a few quick calibration coaching sessions for managers next week. :calendar:

lin (CTO): Appreciate the follow-up. We'll try to carve out time to review edge cases before calibration starts.

sam (IC): super helpful. thanks! :raised_hands:

maya (People Ops): We'll drop a short FAQ doc in #people-ops and ping managers. Keep the questions coming and we'll update the doc.

maya (People Ops): closing the thread for new top-level questions at EOD, but replies and DMs still welcome. Thanks y'all!
